items.html: And it is found that the measure of the stature of Leah and Rachel is one above the other, and their beginning is from the Daat of ZA until the end of his NHY. But they themselves are longer and higher than this measure, because if the Keter of Rachel did not clothe the feet of Leah, but rather its place were below the feet of Leah, then the feet of Rachel would need to spread further down below the feet of ZA, and she would necessarily enter into the boundary of the world of Beria.
